events.headline: Reprompt AI team joins Rippling
events.summary: Reprompt founders Lukas Martinelli and Rob Balian and their team joined Rippling to develop AI agents that handle changing company data and perform customer tasks.

events.headline: Rippling integrates CrowdStrike endpoint protection into Device Management
events.summary: Customers can now purchase, deploy and manage CrowdStrike endpoint protection, monitor sensor status and review device threats within Rippling.

events.headline: Rippling launches Partner Directory
events.summary: The new directory connects businesses with accounting firms and HR advisors through partner profiles, expertise and industry experience.

events.headline: Neel Murthy promoted to Chief Marketing Officer
events.summary: Reporting published on this date announced Murthy's promotion from Vice President of Growth to Chief Marketing Officer during October.

events.headline: Rippling expands Automated Compliance
events.summary: The release adds multi-framework support, broader integrations, an audit portal, publishable trust centers and AI workflows for setup, remediation and security questionnaires.

events.headline: Starting price returns to Rippling's pricing FAQ
events.summary: A dated review identifies an FAQ update restoring a starting price of $8 per employee per month plus a monthly base fee, replacing wording without a price; as_of 2026-10-13.

events.headline: Preferred Carrier Program expands with Principal, Beam Benefits and Sun Life
events.summary: Rippling added the carriers to provide deeper benefits integrations, coordinated operations and service, and joint product collaboration.

events.headline: Rippling announces expanded New York City office
events.summary: The new office at 330 West 34th Street nearly doubles Rippling's previous New York footprint and is designed to support more than 1,000 employees; as_of 2026-10-08.

events.headline: Rippling AI introduces plugins, skills and automations
events.summary: Plugins connect business systems, skills package reusable instructions, and announced automations run recurring work under existing permissions; automations were waitlisted.

cost_basis: tokens x list price + $10 per 1K web search calls
